en: Dependent on a root-conditioned state accompanied by applied thought and sustained thought, there arises a non-root-conditioned state not accompanied by applied thought and sustained thought, by way of root-condition... Three [answers] under root; ... up to ... three under non-disappearance.

Dependent on a root-conditioned state without applied thought but with sustained thought, there arises a non-root-conditioned state without applied thought and without sustained thought, by way of root-condition... Three [answers] under root; ... up to ... three under non-disappearance.

Dependent on a non-root-conditioned state without applied thought and without sustained thought, there arises a non-non-root-conditioned state without applied thought and without sustained thought, by way of root-condition... Three [answers] under root; ... up to ... three under non-disappearance.
